title: A Benders loop checked against every plan
heading: The Master Is an Upper Bound, Each Plan's True Value a Lower Bound; Stop When They Meet
cases: when no station saves more than it costs to build, the loop ends with nothing built and the cost of buying all the water
the loop keeps adding cuts until the master's value meets the best plan's cost, and returns the cheapest of all plans
the cost reported in each iteration is the best plan found so far, so it never rises
